title: Health retention prune holds the write lock for 5 to 33 s and never removes dead letters

design_summary.root_cause: prune_retained_history previously executed SELECT dependency_ids_json FROM delivery_outbox WHERE status <> 'delivered' inside a BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, loading 882,978 non-delivered rows into Python and json.loads-parsing each row before running unindexed DELETE statements that only removed status='delivered' rows and never pruned dead_letter or quarantined rows.
fix: Compute protected outbox_rowid values entirely in SQL inside temp.delivery_prune_protected using a WITH RECURSIVE CTE over active incident_mappings (status IN ('opening', 'open', 'resolving')) and retained delivery_outbox rows with non-empty dependencies via covering partial index delivery_outbox_deps_idx.

Extend 7-day retention pruning (604,800 s) to status IN ('delivered', 'dead_letter', 'quarantined') and delete bounded batches (_DELIVERY_PRUNE_BATCH_SIZE = 3,500) ordered by updated_at via partial index delivery_outbox_prune_idx.

Delete bounded batches from probe_windows (24 h retention), error_windows (24 h retention), and delivery_replay_audit (7 d retention) using covering indexes probe_windows_completed_idx, error_windows_observed_idx, and delivery_replay_audit_replayed_idx.

When any prune batch reaches _DELIVERY_PRUNE_BATCH_SIZE, DownstreamHealthMonitor.get_state() schedules the next prune after one probe interval (30 s on hosted dev) instead of waiting 300 s, returning to 300 s once the backlog drains.
Do not run VACUUM from code; operator compacts the hosted file once after the backlog drains.

ac2_sql_protected_dependencies_and_bound.bounded_vm_steps_test: test_prune_computes_protected_dependencies_in_sql_and_reads_bounded_rows verifies via sqlite3 set_trace_callback and set_progress_handler that pruning 100 rows on 20,000 vs 2,000 non-delivered rows never executes SELECT dependency_ids_json FROM delivery_outbox WHERE status <> 'delivered' and keeps SQLite VM steps bounded.

ac3_dead_letter_and_quarantined_retentio.verified_by: test_dead_letter_and_quarantined_retention_and_replay_within_retention proves dead_letter, quarantined, and delivered rows >7d old are deleted in bounded batches while dead_letter rows <7d old remain in delivery_outbox and are successfully replayed and delivered via monitor.replay_dead_letters.

All create_delivery_id and incident_open/incident_resolve rows for opening_event_id/last_event_id of incident_mappings with status IN ('opening', 'open', 'resolving'), plus their direct and transitive dependencies when not yet delivered

ac8_existing_tests_integrity.justification: No existing test or assertion was modified, weakened, or deleted. All 118 pre-existing tests in test_downstream_health_monitor.py and test_bff_downstream_health_monitor.py plus test_l12_bff_recovery_survives_delivered_history_retention pass unchanged.
